tasks.label: DarkLantern64: Build + Play loot counter
tasks.detail: Build the saved moonlit yard and launch directly at its Blender-made loot display. Save + Cook first.

tasks.label: DarkLantern64: Open loot in Blender
tasks.detail: Open art/loot.blend for interactive editing. Save the .blend before exporting.

tasks.label: DarkLantern64: Export Blender loot assets
tasks.detail: Export the saved art/loot.blend to content/assets/loot/pack.json without changing any level.

tasks.label: DarkLantern64: Package Blender export add-on
tasks.detail: Create build/darklantern64_export.zip for manual installation in Blender.

tasks.label: DarkLantern64: Recreate loot demo (overwrites loot.blend)
tasks.detail: Regenerate the five example props and export pack, replacing art/loot.blend. Preserve your edits in another source file first.

tasks.label: DarkLantern64: Build + Play level select
tasks.detail: Bundle the saved Lantern Store, moonlit yard and enemy workshop into one ROM with a level-select screen.

tasks.label: DarkLantern64: Build + Play test start
tasks.detail: Launch directly into a named test start in the enemy workshop. Save + Cook first.

tasks.label: DarkLantern64: Verify level switching
tasks.detail: Exercise the selector, every bundled test start, restart and resume in isolated Ares runs.

tasks.label: DarkLantern64: Open enemy workshop
tasks.detail: Edit three enemies, their types, patrol routes and sentry posts.

tasks.label: DarkLantern64: Save + Cook enemy workshop
tasks.detail: Save the open enemy workshop and refresh its models and waypoint markers.

tasks.label: DarkLantern64: Build + Play enemy workshop
tasks.detail: Build the saved three-enemy level and launch it in Ares. Save + Cook first.

tasks.label: DarkLantern64: Scale study
tasks.detail: Measure guard/light workloads and compare eight saved-courtyard fixtures with bounds culling on/off in isolated Ares runs.

tasks.label: DarkLantern64: Guard + light workload study
tasks.detail: Run the short isolated CPU workload diagnostic; excludes drawing, animation and inter-guard behavior.

tasks.label: DarkLantern64: Save + Cook courtyard (editor must be open)
tasks.detail: Save the running courtyard workshop and refresh its cooked preview.

tasks.label: DarkLantern64: Validate saved courtyard
tasks.detail: Check the saved courtyard, models and texture recipes.

tasks.label: DarkLantern64: Open courtyard editor
tasks.detail: Edit the separate moonlit courtyard, including shared texture materials and night lighting.

tasks.label: DarkLantern64: Build + Play courtyard
tasks.detail: Build the saved courtyard and launch it in Ares. Save + Cook editor changes first.

tasks.label: DarkLantern64: Capture courtyard views
tasks.detail: Build a diagnostic ROM and export actual N64 framebuffers at the authored cameras. Save changes first.

tasks.label: DarkLantern64: Open editor
tasks.detail: Build and open the LightEngine editor for this project.

tasks.label: DarkLantern64: Validate saved level
tasks.detail: Check the saved first_room.json and its model assets. Save editor changes first.

tasks.label: DarkLantern64: Save + Cook (editor must be open)
tasks.detail: Ask the running editor to save level changes and generate the preview and game data.

tasks.label: DarkLantern64: Build game
tasks.detail: Cook saved content and build the N64 ROM. Save editor changes first.

tasks.label: DarkLantern64: Build + Play game
tasks.detail: Build saved content and open the game in Ares with 8 MiB memory enabled.

tasks.label: DarkLantern64: Report game profile
tasks.detail: Summarize completed profiling windows from the latest Ares play session.

inputs.description: Choose the enemy workshop's starting state
